name: TreedList
access: OML creates this object from a selector:TreedList node. Reach the instance with find or cfind, then call methods on that instance. Method names are not OML keys.

properties.name: types
properties.description: Required when renderer is Tree. The same types object Tree expects. Optional.

properties.name: renderer
properties.description: Tree, StackedTree, or RouletteTree. Defaults to Tree. Optional.

properties.name: list
properties.description: Items. An OGX.List is preferred. Optional.

properties.name: group_param
properties.description: Grouping options. An array or a string. Optional.

catalog_status: Listed fields are OML config from the OGX.JS wiki. Methods are not listed. Use inherited true for documented base classes. Do not invent members that are absent.
